newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer shares leap on Medica IPO.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer shares leap on Medica IPO.

text.p: Shares in engineering group Sulzer AG jumped as much as 19 percent in early Swiss trade after the group said it would list its medical technology unit Medica on the stock market.
Sulzer registered shares opened at 990 Swiss francs and went as high as 1,000 Swiss francs, up 19.3 percent from a closing at 838 francs on Monday. The low end was at 961 francs.
At 0940 GMT, Sulzer registered shares were trading around 973 Swiss francs, up 135 francs or 16 percent.
Traders said the boost came from Sulzer's pre-bourse announcement that it would put Medica on the bourse in order to raise capital for the unit's growth through acquisitions.
"This was exactly the step that the market has long demanded," one trader said about the public offering.

Traders said the share benefitted because the Medica announcement was seen as showing management actively working on reviving the group, which expects a lower 1996 net profit after a 52 percent plunge to 92 million Swiss francs in 1995. -- Zurich Newsroom, +41-1-631 7340
